name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition
notes: C-Engine DX11/DX12 → D3DMetal (Skyrim/FO4 class). Steam's Reloaded Edition (534380) replaced the original Stay Human SKU. Launch DyingLightGame_x64_rwdi.exe from ph/work/bin/x64. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal; prefer the in-game DX11 renderer if device creation fails. Denuvo was removed; co-op uses EOS, not a kernel anti-cheat. Ray tracing is DX12-only. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
